summary: This paper resolves all three open questions posed by Kitzinger, Eisert, and Kunjwal (arXiv:2611.34872v1) on multi-qubit bound magic from PPT Pauli channels. First (Theorem 2), an exact rational Motzkin-Burger and Balinski completeness proof classifies all 252 extreme rays of PPT_2 (60 stabilizer-dephasing channels and 192 rank-6 C_5-cycle channels), shows every Orbit-2 channel violates the universal EB_n Cauchy-Schwarz l_1 ceiling (5 > 3), and certifies I - E(A_j) >= 0 across all 8 Clifford facet orbits (22,320 facets) of STAB_2 via 1,536 exact 8x8 realified LDL^T factorizations, proving B_2 = STAB_2 and Conjecture 4 at n=2 unconditionally while refuting its converse (EB_2 subsetneq PPT_2 subseteq MB_2). Second (Theorem 3), Z[i] Gaussian-sum phase rigidity establishes a universal magic witness for odd-k stabilizer pairs (<u|v> = 2^{-k/2}), yielding closed-form depolarizing robustness > 5.72% for odd n >= 3, and proves that for every even n=2m >= 2 the flag states collapse identically into STAB_{2m} as uniform mixtures of Arf-0 or Arf-1 nondegenerate real quadratic stabilizer states. Third (Theorem 4), an S_n-symmetric, non-Clifford-factorizable family G_n^{(delta)} certifies bound magic for all even n >= 4 for 0 < delta < delta_crit(n) with universal floor 2(2-sqrt(2))/3 > 1/3.
strengths: Complete, zero-floating-point proof of B_2 = STAB_2 via exact rational Motzkin-Burger tangent-cone double description (Balinski connectedness) and 1,536 exact 8x8 realified LDL^T PSD certificates.
Clean refutation of the converse of Conjecture 4 at n=2 using a simple universal Cauchy-Schwarz l_1 ceiling for EB_n (Lemma 1) paired with the 192 rank-6 C_5-cycle PPT channels.

Deep structural explanation of the odd/even parity dichotomy: Z[i] Gaussian-sum rigidity yields a universal odd-k witness, whereas even-n flag states collapse into STAB_{2m} as exact Arf-invariant uniform mixtures.
Explicit, S_n-symmetric, non-Clifford-factorizable bound-magic family for all even n >= 4 with exact monotone threshold in Q(sqrt(2)), backed by Lean 4 verification and 56 adversarial pytest checks.
weaknesses: Conjecture 4 (EB_n subseteq MB_n) remains open for n >= 3 (supported only by numerical sweeps at n=3), and genuine n-partite bound magic (whether 3-qubit marginals of rho_B^(4)(1/3) lie in STAB_3) is left open.
The Lean 4 formalization (18 theorems) verifies the scalar algebraic, combinatorial, and Z[sqrt(2)] inequality cores rather than the full Hilbert-space, Clifford-group, and polytope definitions.
Full rank of rho_B^(n)(1/3) is explicitly certified at n=4 rather than proved for all even n >= 4.

Universal odd-k magic witness from Z[i] Gaussian-sum phase rigidity and exact Arf-invariant uniform stabilizer-mixture collapse for all even n = 2m >= 2.
